Mods for Conker's Bad Fur Day: Recompiled
https://github.com/sciaschi/CBFD-Recompiled

These .nrm files work with the Windows, Linux and macOS versions alike.

Installing
  1. Start ConkerRecomp and open the Mods menu.
  2. Drop the .nrm files onto it, or copy them into the mods folder of the data
     folder (the Mods menu can open it).
  3. Enable the ones you want. Some have options there too.

  conker_skip_intro.nrm         Skip Intro: boots straight to the main menu.
  conker_skip_any_cutscene.nrm  Skip Any Cutscene: L skips a cutscene even the
                                first time you see it.
  conker_cheats.nrm             Cheats: infinite health, infinite lives and a
                                full wallet, each toggled in the mod's options.
